title: Register Git\bin\bash.exe wrapper and fallback MSYS PATH for Windows susi-release-sync task
goal: Vision: V-3. Rewrite MSYS2 \usr\bin\bash.exe to sibling \bin\bash.exe and reject System32/SysWOW64/WindowsApps stubs when registering susi-release-sync on Windows, and bootstrap /usr/bin PATH in susi-release-sync.sh when dirname is absent.

reuse.reason: Extended install-timer bash resolution in susi-release-sync-windows.ps1 and startup PATH fallback in susi-release-sync.sh.
